body: Expand detail tracing beyond the current hard-coded pool subset. `crates/tank_core/src/tracing.rs:154-220` snapshots only selected fields, but systems mutate other state that never appears in `pool_deltas`, for example `system:stability_tracker` updates `stability_tracker.instability_index` and the tracker baselines in `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:96-123`, and `system:daily_shrimp` mutates reproductive state in `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs:384-505`. At detail verbosity those stages can emit empty deltas even when they changed state, and `crates/tank_core/src/tracing.rs:92-94` then silently reports `0.0` for absent pools. Either trace all mutation-relevant state or surface unsupported pools explicitly instead of treating 'untracked' as 'unchanged'.
